description: This file defines the FreeMarkerViewHandler class, which extends AbstractViewHandler and provides methods to initialize the handler, prepare the view context with necessary objects, and render FreeMarker templates in a web application environment.

classes.name: FreeMarkerViewHandler
classes.description: A view handler that manages FreeMarker templates within the OFBiz web application framework. It initializes the FreeMarker configuration, prepares the data model for templates, and renders templates with proper error handling.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the FreeMarker configuration with the application's servlet context and cache settings.

methods.name: prepareViewContext
methods.description: Prepares the data model for the template rendering by adding various OFBiz-specific objects, session, request, and security information.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the specified FreeMarker template with the provided context, handling output to the HTTP response and managing exceptions.
